## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the concrete trigger, the change and the affected evidence scope.

## Validation

State the checks run and their results. For scoring changes, show the old and new numerator/denominator behaviour and identify affected records.

## Evidence and compatibility

- [ ] Public or synthetic examples only; no credentials or active held-out gold.
- [ ] Original evidence and historical releases remain identifiable.
- [ ] Changed semantics, migration requirements and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Relevant generated artifacts and wiki source are updated and checked.
